articles.title: Bank earnings: What else to expect as JPMorgan comes under pressure
articles.mainIdea: Bank earnings: What else to expect as JPMorgan comes under pressure
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Bank earnings: What else to expect as JPMorgan comes under pressure. While JPMorgan Chase (JPM) kicks off earnings season for Big Banks this week, HSBC Head of US Financials Research Saul Martinez talks about his earnings forecast for other banking institutions this week. Also watch Saul Martinez discuss JPMorgan's latest earnings release and what President Trump's proposed 10% cap on credit card rates could mean for credit lenders. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: BAC, BK-PK, BLK, C, GS, JPM, MS, MS-PQ, WFC.
